data.title: 时崎狂三 · 黑夜天台
data.description: 【时崎狂三 · 黑夜天台】夜幕下的都市天台被阴冷的气流席卷，狂三双手优雅地反握着长短两柄复古燧发枪，枪口处缭绕着尚未散尽的紫色灵力微光。她轻歪着头凝视着你，宛如黑夜中漫步的梦魇——「真是个好奇心过剩的人呢。不过……能够走到这一步的你，已经没有逃跑的退路了哦。」
data.action: 持双燧发枪站在天台边缘
data.camera: full-body shot, rooftop edge and both weapons visible
data.promptProse: At the midnight rooftop edge, Kurumi lowers a long antique musket and a short flintlock pistol in theatrical reversed grips, one weapon in each hand. Violet energy curls near their muzzles as she tilts her head with a questioning smile. The wide full-body view keeps both weapons against distant illuminated windows. Cool moonlight defines her sailor collar and skirt folds, while city reflections mark the roof's edge.
